featured_reviews.name: Deepika Pote
featured_reviews.review_text:
There are moments in life when your mind feels trapped in an endless loop of thoughts… when problems don’t just stay outside, they follow you everywhere. That’s exactly where we were... when we decided to try the Kohinoor room at Mystery Room, Andheri West..
and honestly, we didn’t realize then how much we needed it.
From the moment we entered, the energy shifted. The staff welcomed us with such warmth..always smiling, patient, and genuinely excited for us. It didn’t feel like just another activity; it felt like someone quietly telling us, “You’re going to feel better here.”
And then the game began.
What I loved the most was how brilliantly the clues were designed...hilarious, clever, and surprisingly nostalgic.. It was a reminder ...It felt like everything I had ever studied, observed, or casually learned in life was suddenly coming together. Each puzzle wasn’t just a task...it was a spark. A distraction. A reminder that the mind can still play, think, and solve… even when it feels heavy.
There were moments we laughed uncontrollably...cant tell you d exact details , moments we got stuck, and moments where we just looked at each other and said, “Wait… could it be this?” And when things started clicking, it wasn’t just about solving the room...it felt like breaking through something inside us. We dint panic ,got angry, or blamed each other but were focused on problem solving..
And then… that bell rang.
That sound ..it wasn’t just a signal that we had completed the task in hand... It was a jolt.... The exact jolt we didn’t know we needed... For those few minutes, we weren’t thinking about stress, worries, or anything weighing us down. We were just present, quick..and connected... We dint think ... We just did what needed to be done ..and laughed out our hearts....
We walked out lighter. Clearer. Almost reset.
If you’re feeling stuck, overwhelmed, or just mentally exhausted, this place is more than just an escape room. It’s a pause. A shift. A small but powerful break from the chaos inside your head.
For me and my sister, it wasn’t just an experience...it was a moment of healing.
A must-visit. Truly one of the best experiences we’ve ever had.

The room was packed with intricate puzzles and clever clues that kept us on our toes every single second. It felt like we were in a real-life spy movie, racing against time to steal the diamond.

featured_reviews.name: Pravandu Panchal
featured_reviews.review_text:
Play 'n Learn is an exceptional destination that truly understands how to create a fun and engaging environment for children. From the moment you step inside, it's clear that this establishment prioritizes both entertainment and safety. The sheer variety of activities on offer ensures that every child, regardless of their interests, will find something to capture their imagination. 🤩

The staff at Play 'n Learn deserve significant commendation for their remarkable responsibility and attentiveness. Parents can relax knowing that their children are under a watchful and caring eye, allowing for a genuinely stress-free experience. This commitment to supervision, coupled with ample space for parents to unwind while still observing their little ones, creates a harmonious atmosphere where everyone can enjoy their time. Adding to the delightful experience, one of the staff members even came dressed as a beloved cartoon character, leading a dance activity that brought all the children together. This performance was delivered with such dedication and enthusiasm, set to delightful music, and it was evident that the kids absolutely loved every moment. 💃🕺🎶

The imaginative play opportunities at Play 'n Learn are particularly impressive. Children can dive into a world of pretend, acting as sellers or buyers at a vibrant fruit and veggie stand, fostering early concepts of commerce and interaction. 🥕🍎 For budding engineers, the chance to fix cars as mechanics provides a hands-on experience that sparks creativity. 🛠️ The facility also encourages empathy and care through activities like playing doctor or running a pretend vet clinic, allowing children to explore crucial social roles. 🩺🐾 Beyond structured play, there's a charming cafe within the premises, offering a good variety of food, coffee, and chai for those who need a culinary break. ☕🍰 Kids can also cruise around in their own foot-powered cars, adding another layer of physical activity and fun. 🚗💨

The dynamic play zones are equally captivating. A massive ball pit invites children to jump and "swim" through a sea of colorful spheres, providing endless laughter and physical engagement. 🤩🏊 The excitement continues with a range of musical instruments, cool slides that promise thrilling descents, and a bouncy trampoline perfect for energetic jumps. 🎶🎢🤸 For those with a building inclination, foam blocks allow for creative construction, while a pulley system offers a fascinating way to lift blocks high, introducing basic principles of mechanics. 🏗️🔗

Beyond the activities, the overall ambiance of Play 'n Learn is truly inviting. The carefully curated music selection is perfect for children, creating a lively yet pleasant backdrop. 🎵 The walls, adorned with calm, soft colors, contribute to a soothing and aesthetically pleasing environment. 🎨 A two-hour play session proves to be the ideal duration, providing ample time for children to explore and engage without becoming overtired. My child had an absolute blast, and I wholeheartedly recommend Play 'n Learn to any family seeking a memorable and enriching play experience. ✨

Every corner looks vibrant and thoughtfully created, making it perfect for kids who love animals.

What really stood out to me was the mix of fun and learning. They have interactive setups like a bank counter, kitchen area, shopping mall and even a doctor’s clinic, which makes it engaging for kids while also being educational. There are plenty of activities to keep them busy along with cute rides and play areas.

The highlight has to be the crazy maze castle, it’s honestly something you need to experience to understand how exciting it is. I genuinely felt like I wish I was a kid again to enjoy it fully, even adults can have a great time here watching and being part of the fun.

Another thing I really appreciated is how many staff members are always around. They are very attentive and make sure the kids are safe and enjoying at all times. Even if you’re busy or just want to relax for a bit, you can trust them to take good care of your kids. It definitely feels like a very safe and well-managed environment.

They also have a very cute café serving pure vegetarian food. We tried pizza, pasta, fries, boba drinks and coffee, everything was quite good and perfect after all the activities.

I also got to know that the place can be booked for kids’ birthday parties and celebrations, which honestly makes it even more special.

Overall it’s truly a unique experience and definitely one of Mumbai’s first jungle adventure themed parks. I would highly recommend this place to anyone with kids, it’s something they’re going to absolutely love

featured_reviews.review_text: One of the best place to get your little one 😉.The staff is very good and they take good care of your kids.The play area is good and my kid loves it especially the sandpit area.And the other slides are also very good.One last thing don't miss out on their cafe it's just awesome especially their white sauce pasta it's just mouth watering.I recommend everyone to visit this place with ur kids

featured_reviews.name: Rahul Patil
featured_reviews.review_text: The Jungle Adventure Park in Girgaon, Mumbai is a fun, jungle-themed indoor play area that’s great for young kids and family outings. Parents often praise the friendly staff, well-maintained setup, and safe environment, making it good value for a couple of hours of playtime. Slides, soft-play areas and active zones keep little ones engaged, and it’s also considered a nice spot for birthday celebrations. Some parents note it’s best suited for younger children rather than teens, but overall it’s a lively and enjoyable play zone with solid reviews and a welcoming vibe.

featured_reviews.name: SATISH MEHTA
featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently visited this play area and had an absolutely wonderful experience! The space is very clean, well-maintained, and thoughtfully designed for kids of all age groups. The play equipment is safe, colorful, and engaging, which kept the children happily occupied for hours.
What impressed us the most was the friendly and attentive staff who ensured everything was organized and secure. The environment feels safe, hygienic, and full of positive energy. It’s the perfect place for kids to have fun, socialize, and burn off some energy.
Highly recommended for birthday parties, playdates, or just a fun family outing. We will definitely be visiting again! 😊

featured_reviews.name: Sachin Talekar
featured_reviews.review_text: Superb place for children to spend adventurous time full of fun. Lots of activities to explore and all the adventures are very nice and specially designed for kids. With adequate staff to guide all the time.

featured_reviews.name: tanmay dhoke
featured_reviews.review_text: Visited First Time But It Was Really Wholesomely Beautiful Kid's Play Area Built So Innovatively With Wonderful Staff Member's Miss Vaishanvi Sajana & Darshana Madam To Be Around Small Kid's Guiding And Playing With Outmost Safety. Must Visit Worth The Value Of Money 💐👌🏻👍🏻

name: Clue Hunt Lower Parel

The game caters to ages 9+ years and is a suitable entertainment option for a birthday party, corporate team activity or even a fun weekend outing. We have 6 different mystery themes to choose from: prison-break mystery, defusing time bomb , diamond hunt mystery, art theft mystery, kidnapping themed mystery games. We are located next to Todi Social and we continue to be the #1 ranked thing to do under fun & games on TripAdvisor and is a Hall of Fame awardee. Call us to book a slot at our outlet or to plan a customised game at your private party at an offsite venue.

featured_reviews.name: Suryakant Pandey
featured_reviews.review_text:
Cluehunt is a good team building and entertainment place for groups, teams and couples. The games would test your mental agility, team working and patience. There are almost 4-5 games here, each one will take almost 2 hrs time to get completed. I must say that those games are designed in a very smart way to add elements of surprise, thrill and fun all along the game. Highly recommended for a small team get together. I took my team before a dinner and it was a wholesome fun. Quite energising!!
This place place is located in the heart of the lower parel in Mumbai and doesn't offer any parking facility, so best to go by hired cabs. The best part is it's surrounding, you may find so many highly rated restaurants nearby to dine. Try once with your close groups this  play and dine area.

featured_reviews.name: Sunkist Mehta
featured_reviews.review_text: The terrorist room is good for beginners. Good to try out with a group of friends once. Definitely not worth the high prices.

featured_reviews.name: Rutuja Jawale
featured_reviews.review_text: Had lots of fun at the Lower Parel branch.. the clues are interesting and we need to play it smart.. that one hour in the lock up room went damn fast like we were busy finding the clues and having fun too! Amazing place! Would like to come again and try other puzzles.

featured_reviews.name: Satyak rajhansa
featured_reviews.review_text:
If your looking for a great way to spend some quality time with Friends and Family this is the place. Engage and Work as a team to solve Puzzles and work out a way to escape. No distraction like mobile phones and a fun filled real adventure which you will always remember.
Its a much better idea to spend time here than a mall.

featured_reviews.name: sakshi mittal
featured_reviews.review_text: It was a really pleasant experience at the Lower Parel Clue Hunt. Interesting and intelligently planned clues! Super fun. Friendly organisers. An "atypical" way spending time in the city! Recommend you to visit this place.

featured_reviews.name: Chinmay Raut
featured_reviews.review_text: Good place to visit if you like solving puzzles.. You have to solve a puzzle within an hour and you can ask upto 3 hints... After that, for every hint they reduce 5 mins from your remaining time as a penalty....  Minimum 2 and maximum 6 people can be part of a team.

featured_reviews.name: Huzefa Sitabkhan
featured_reviews.review_text: Amazing experience at the Lower Parel branch. Did the Diamond maze and finished it 10 mins before time. I honest feedback- they should add some incentives​ to make the game more competitive and something to look forward to.

featured_reviews.name: Safiya Mustafa
featured_reviews.review_text: I took my daughters gang of friends to celebrate her birthday here in sum different style n I think it was a very good decision ,Girls were so full of energy n excitement..every minute well spent! Superb place if ur looking for sum thrill

featured_reviews.name: Akshay Momaya
featured_reviews.review_text:
One word review: Loved it!

Can’t express in words how much fun this event was.

My entire group enjoyed this game and loved the way team handled the booking, instructions and how they narrated us throughout the game to ensure our gameplay was smooth as well as fun.

Bonus: The Zero Latency team also recorded a really nice video and clicked great pictures for us.

featured_reviews.name: Niraj Khandwala
featured_reviews.review_text:
This was such an exhilarating experience. Me and my son thoroughly enjoyed these 15 mins. We paymes rhe the Undead game. They have 5-6 different options and I can't wait to try the others.

It's a bit expensive but worth the price. The staff is extremely courteous.

featured_reviews.name: Muskan Dharmani
featured_reviews.review_text:
Tried Zero Latency and honestly… WOW 🤯🔥
Start mein laga 15 minutes toh bas warm-up jaisa hoga, but it turned out to be SUPER intense.
Fully immersive, full focus mode ON, adrenaline rush throughout 🎮💥
Sabse best part? It was such a unique experience for all 6 of us—teamwork, chaos, laughs, panic moments, everything together 😂🤝
No screens, no controllers—bas pure action and next-level fun.
Walked in excited, walked out wanting MORE.
Already can’t wait to go again 🚀🔥

featured_reviews.name: Shoaa Shams
featured_reviews.review_text: I had an absolutely thrilling time at Zero Latency Mumbai! Played Outbreak: Zombie for 30 minutes and the experience was next level. The free-roam VR, realistic weapons, and spine-chilling zombie attacks made it feel like I was living inside a movie. Super immersive, adrenaline-pumping, and a must-try for anyone who loves gaming and thrill. The staff was very polite, the environment was friendly i just wish the Zero Latency team could work on pricing. Its a little bit on the expensice side. But the overall experience is worth it!

featured_reviews.name: Kris Camponi
featured_reviews.review_text: Amazing experience, went today with my son and we had the place to ourselves. Played Far Cry VR. The staff are really helpful and everything is as immersive as you’d expect. Will go again. Thanks to the team for making it so good.

featured_reviews.name: Harsh Jekte
featured_reviews.review_text:
Absolutely thrilling experience!
Honestly felt like I was right in the middle of a real zombie apocalypse. It's a total must-try! On top of the amazing setup, the staff members were incredibly helpful and provided fantastic customer service. Highly recommended!.

featured_reviews.name: Shashank Saxena
featured_reviews.review_text: If you enjoy VR gaming, this is heaven for you. However, if you are playing for the first time, I cannot say that you will not enjoy this place because the gaming experience you will have is one that you will remember for the rest of your life. The executive was also polite and helpful, and they are good photographers, I must say. Everything was perfect, but the customer may encounter some parking issues, so they should work on it.
